review.interaction: Chromium followed the chapter link, moved both vectors by keyboard and dragged the native slider at 375 px. Space selected pair 40, distance 0 preserved the 0.12500 ratio and set the dot to 1, an out-of-range distance hid stale results, and reset restored the initial values. EN controls and decimal formatting verified. At 1280 and 375 px the viewport had no horizontal overflow; reviewed light and dark screenshots. With scripts off, both fieldsets stay disabled and the initial numbers, noscript message and worked text remain.
review.validation: Root and /bookvar builds each produced 2071 pages. Zero broken links in both; the prefixed artifact is 883375328 bytes, below the repository's 1000000000-byte cap. A local HTTP server served the prefixed RU/EN pages and Chromium clicked through from each chapter and selected pair 40. Root: 758 publication tests passed (12 skipped), 274 built-output tests, 93 site tests, four lab tests, Astro check with zero errors. Site tests initially raced the Pages content regeneration; all passed after restoring root-generated content and running them sequentially.
review.release: No commit, push or deployment. Remote dev stayed at 9bd4e7d9e8fba571c3e2467f7388f10874367c97.
